title: Playback
text: Load data from workspace, file, or Simulation Data Inspector, 1 output, no direct feedthrough, {Complexity} sets Complexity of each port; {Number of Ports} sets the number of output ports, {Data Type} sets the output data type for each port Inherit, {Units} sets the physical units for each, {Sample time} sets the output sample period and optional time, {Dimensions}, {Dimension Mode} sets the dimension mode of each port, {Before first point} sets the extrapolation method to determine block output before first data point in loaded data, {After last point} sets the extrapolation method to determine block output after final data point in loaded data, {Enable zero-crossing detection} sets the zero-crossing detection, {Signals} sets the information about signals added to Playback block Simulink.playback.Signal, {Table Placement} sets the position of table, {Time Values} sets the time-based column organization options Union and {Use Signal Interpolation} sets the option to interpolate missing data values. Values come from the instance.

ports.name: Port_1
ports.summary: Data loaded from workspace, file, or Simulation Data Inspector scalar | vector | matrix | array

params.name: Number of Ports
params.values: Number of output ports 0 (default) | integer in the range [ 0,100 ]

params.name: Data Type
params.values: Output data type for each port Inherit: auto (default) | double | single | half | int8 | uint8 | int16 | uint16 | int32 | uint32 | int64 | uint64 | string | boolean | fixdt(1,16,0) | fixdt(1,16,2^0,0) |...

params.name: Units
params.values: Physical units for each port inherit (default) | supported physical unit

params.name: Sample time
params.values: Output sample period and optional time offset -1 | scalar | vector

params.name: Dimensions
params.values: Dimensions of each port " " (default) | integer | integer array

params.name: Before first point
params.values: Extrapolation method to determine block output before first data point in loaded data Linear (default) | Hold First Value | Ground Value

params.name: After last point
params.values: Extrapolation method to determine block output after final data point in loaded data Linear (default) | Hold Last Value | Ground Value

params.name: Signals
params.values: Information about signals added to Playback block Simulink.playback.Signal object

params.name: Table Placement
params.values: Position of table visualization Bottom (default) | Top | Left | Right | Center

params.name: Time Values
params.values: Time-based column organization options Union Time (default) | Shared Time | Individual Time

params.name: Use Signal Interpolation
params.values: Option to interpolate missing data values off (default) | on
